nodemaven-skills-nodemaven-nodemaven-acc.description: Call the NodeMaven dashboard REST API (v2) - traffic left, usage statistics, top domains, the location catalogue (countries, regions, cities, ISPs, zip codes), sub-users and whitelisted IPs. Covers authentication, paging, date format and the endpoints' quirks. Use when the user wants to read their NodeMaven account, automate sub-users or IP whitelisting, or look up valid location codes, from any language or curl.

nodemaven-skills-nodemaven-nodemaven-pro.description: Connect code to NodeMaven residential proxies. Covers the gateway address, the username format for country, region, city and ISP targeting, sticky sessions with ttl, the IP quality filter, rotation, and ready-to-paste setup for Python requests, httpx, aiohttp, curl, Node (undici, axios), Playwright, Puppeteer, Selenium and Scrapy. Use when the user wants to send traffic through NodeMaven, target a location, keep one IP across requests, or rotate IPs.

nodemaven-skills-nodemaven-nodemaven-sdk.description: Write code with the official NodeMaven SDKs - `nodemaven` for Python (PyPI), Rust (crates.io) and Go (github.com/nodemaven/nodemaven-go). Build validated proxy usernames and URLs, sticky sessions, per-worker session pools, check a proxy with one CONNECT, and call the account API client. Use when the user's project is in Python, Rust or Go and needs NodeMaven proxies or account data, or asks which SDK call does something.

nodemaven-skills-nodemaven-proxy-benchma.description: Measure proxies and scraping browsers with the open-source proxy-benchmark harness - success rate on real targets (Google, Bing, DuckDuckGo, Amazon), bytes per page, exit yield, and side-by-side comparison of providers or automation engines (Playwright, Patchright, Camoufox, zendriver, SeleniumBase and others). Use when the user wants to test or compare proxy providers, check which browser gets past a target, estimate traffic cost, or reproduce a published number.

nodemaven-skills-nodemaven-proxy-trouble.description: Diagnose residential proxy failures, with NodeMaven's gateway as the reference - 407 with correct credentials, 406, 410, 500, a connection that hangs, ERR_TUNNEL_CONNECTION_FAILED in a browser, Playwright or Puppeteer ignoring proxy credentials, a sticky session that changes IP, geo-targeting that is silently ignored, passwords with special characters, and unexpected traffic from headless Chrome. Use when a proxy connection fails, returns the wrong location, or costs more traffic than expected.

nodemaven-skills-nodemaven-serpmaven.description: Scrape Google search results (SERP) to JSON with SERP Maven (serpmaven) - a real Chrome browser on a residential proxy with sticky sessions. Run it as a CLI, a Python library, a local HTTP search API (`serve`), an MCP server or a Docker image; set the proxy login, workers, pages and cost tracking. Use when the user wants Google results, rank tracking, a self-hosted SERP API, or live Google search for an AI agent.
